{{Term/Store|Duck|Ducks|Series, BotW, TotK|plural}} are a recurring species in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|ALttP, BotW, TotK}}<ref>{{Cite Guide|ALttP Nintendo|quote= When Link found the Flute and played it in the town square,  he gained the ability to use the pet Duck.|page= 124}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|'''Bright-Chested Duck'''|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|'''Bright-Chested Duck'''|Hyrule Compendium|TotK}}</ref>{{Name Ref|TP, TPHD, FPTRR}}

==Characteristics==
==={{ALttP|-}}===
In {{ALttP}}, a Duck owned by the [[Flute Boy]] appears as a mean of [[Warping|transportation]]. When [[Link]] plays the [[Flute]] near the [[Weathercock]] in the center of [[Kakariko Village]], the Duck will appear from inside the statue. Link can play the Flute again to have the bird fly him to one of eight different locations in the [[Light World]]. Link can also avoid being warped by the Duck if he runs out of the way of the bird's dive after he calls him.

==={{TP|-}}===
Ducks are found in [[Ordon Village]] and in the [[Fishing Hole]] in {{TP}}. They can either be found swimming in the pond or walking along the banks. As [[Wolf Link]], Link can talk to them. One of the Ducks in the Fishing Hole tells him how to get the [[Sinking Lure]].

==={{BotW|-}}===
{{Main|Bright-Chested Duck}}
[[Bright-Chested Duck]]s appear in {{BotW}}. These waterfowl can be found on the surface of ponds and rivers, often in flocks of three or more. If [[Link]] approaches them, they will fly away.
